W.note: Face lifts 3px over 220ms on a cubic-bezier(0.33,1,0.68,1) while a pre-blurred glow fades in over 180ms and lingers on a 620ms (0.22,1,0.36,1) tail, with full focus-visible and reduced-motion handling and a contrast check, so it is the most complete answer to both halves of the brief.

X.note: The aura, sheen, drifting gradient and floating motes are the most dreamlike, but hover durations run 900 to 1600ms, background-position and box-shadow repaint on every frame, and white label text on the sky end of the gradient is weak for legibility.

Y.note: Transform and opacity only, with a 180ms settle lift, a 420ms glow-in and a 700ms tail and a clean reduced-motion fallback, but the pale lavender face makes the primary button look like the ghost and the glow is faint.

Z.note: The gradient drift and halo are pleasant, but letter-spacing animates on hover and reflows neighbouring buttons, reduced-motion users get no hover feedback at all, and the shimmer pseudo-element is not clipped so a white sheen is visible beside the button at rest.
